title: Boys and Girls
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael attempts to engage with his team and create a 'guys in the workplace' event, despite Jan's instructions. The episode features discussions about workplace dynamics, gender issues, and team bonding, with conflicts arising over unionization and management strategies. Michael also tries to connect with his team through various activities and conversations, revealing his motivations and relationships with colleagues.
